title: Alchemy settings schema
description: A file of indra/cvars: an area's groups and settings, each [area.group.key] a setting where it has a type and a group otherwise. Written by alcvargen --json-schema; doc/CVARS.md says how to use them.

label.description: The group's name in the interface; the key in words where left out.

help.description: What the group's settings are for.

scope.description: Whose values its settings are, where a setting does not say.

backup.description: Whether a backup takes its settings, where a setting does not say.

preset.description: The kind of preset that takes its settings, where a setting does not say.

origin.description: Where its settings came from, where a setting does not say.

default.description: Its value until the user sets one, in its type. Required.

help.description: What it does, as its tooltip says it. Required.

label.description: Its name in the interface; the key in words where left out.

scope.description: Whose value it is: the machine's, the account's, or the session's alone, never stored. Its group's where left out.

range.description: [lowest, highest]: the values it may hold; one outside is clamped.

ui_range.description: [lowest, highest]: what a slider or spinner offers, within range.

unit.description: What its number measures. A unit changed is a step of the lock.

choices.description: The values it may take, each with its label: { value = "label", ... }, or [{ value = ..., label = "...", was = [...] }, ...], `was` naming the values that became it.

flags.description: How it is shown and kept.

tags.description: Generations that move whenever a setting carrying the tag changes: lower_snake names.

validate.description: The registered validator every write of it runs.

alias.description: An old name it was stored under: "Name", or { name = "...", inverted, encoding = "string", joined = "<separator>", unit }, or a list of them.

origin.description: Where it came from. Its group's where left out.

migrate.description: What became of stored values at a step of the lock: a list, an entry a step, [{ step = <n>, map = { old = new, ... }, else = "keep" | "default" | <value> }], scale and offset, reset = true, fn = "<hook>", or join = { "<decl>" = { ... } } to end a fork.

backup.description: Whether a backup takes it. Its group's where left out.

preset.description: The kind of preset that takes it. Its group's where left out.

asset.description: The kind of file a string names: its value is a bare file name.

refers.description: What a UUID refers to. Required for a UUID.

from.description: Settings it takes its first value from where it has none of its own: [{ name = "<setting>", fn = "<hook>" }, ...].

reuse.description: Declares again a name renamed away or retired, as a history of its own that its old values never meet.

inverted.description: A boolean that said the opposite

encoding.description: A UUID or a list kept in a string

joined.description: A list kept in a string, its elements joined by this

unit.description: The unit the old name's values were in

map.description: A value of the step before to what it becomes: numbers or strings, as each step holds them

else.description: "keep": the value as it was; "default": the setting's default; or a value of its own

step.description: The step of the lock it begins: 2 or later

map.description: A value of the step before to what it becomes: numbers or strings, as each step holds them

else.description: "keep": the value as it was; "default": the setting's default; or a value of its own

join.description: Ends a fork: each of the other branch's steps, by its fingerprint, answered

fn.description: The registered migration that gives the value
